newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Duma to read foreign borrowing bill on Fri.
newsitem.headline: Russian Duma to read foreign borrowing bill on Fri.

text.p: Russia's State Duma lower parliament house will on Friday vote on a bill to raise government foreign borrowing to $3.40 billion from $2.95 billion, Deputy Finance Minister Mikhail Kasyanov said on Tuesday.

"(Under the bill) we shall increase the volume of borrowing to over $3 billion at the expense of cutting other sources of borrowing," Kasyanov told Reuters, adding that under the bill, Russia's total 1997 foreign borrowing would amount to $9.80 billion.
The $3.4 billion includes Russia's two million mark Eurobond issued in March and a forthcoming Eurobond issue, planned for the second half of June, he said.
He said that Duma approval of the bill was all that was needed for the proposal to become law.
